supupphita.cp: adj. covered with flowers; fully blown.
supupphita.p: [ su + puppha + ta. Supuppha + ita. Pupphaṃ jātaṃ assāti pupphitaṃ. Kappadduma. Moga, 4. 45. Su + puၑpita-saṃ. ] (ti) Google Translate (1) well-always-open-open Well-flowered. (2) Like a well-blooming flower.

C: supupphita：[adj．] covered with flowers； fully blown．
R:
supupphita：သု-ပုပ္ဖိတ （တိ）
ကောင်းစွာ ပွင့်သည်။

supubbaṇha.p: [ su + pubba + aṇha. Ahana=ahna=anha-aṇha. Supūṅvāhṇa-saṃ. Su + puvvaṇha-prā. ] (pu) Google Translate Good-front-of-the-day-noon-in-the-morning.

R:
supubbaṇha：သု-ပုဗ္ဗဏှ （ပ）
ကောင်းသော နံနက်အခါ။

supupphitagga.p: [ supupphita + agga ] (ti) Google Translate with well-opened branches, from the fever, which blooms well; really

supupphitasālarukkhamūla.p: [ supupphitasāla-rukkha + mūla ] (na) Google Translate Soupapfitatashalamula-see.

supūjita.p: [ su + pūja + ta. Su + pūjita-saṃ. Su + pūjiya-prā. ] (ti) Google Translate which should be offered well.

supūra.p: [ su + pūra + a ] (ti) Google Translate Easy to fill - Easy to fill.

supūrita.p: [ su + pūra + (ṇe) + ta. Su + pūrita-saṃ. Su + pūriya-prā. ] (ti) Google Translate (1) Well filled. (2) Well-fulfilled.
